sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.skill = 'SQL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.posting_key)
FROM
  fct_posting AS T1
INNER JOIN
  posting_skills AS T2
ON
  T1.posting_key = T2.posting_key
WHERE
  T1.family = 'Data Analyst' AND T1.remote_us = TRUE AND T1.is_open = TRUE
